'''Nicolás "Nico" Brussino''' (born 2 March 1993) is an Argentine-Italian professional [[basketball]] player for [[Basket Zaragoza|Zaragoza]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]]. He also represents the senior [[Argentine national basketball team|Argentine national team]] in international competition. Standing at {{height|m=2.01}}, he plays at the [[small forward]] position.

==Professional career==
===Regatas Corrientes (2012–2015)===
After two years playing for San Martín de Marcos Juárez,<ref>{{cite web|first=Mariana|last=Alegre|url=http://lanaranjaenelaire.com.ar/2011/08/03/tna-san-martin-de-marcos-juarez-va-tomando-forma/|title=TNA: San Martín de Marcos Juárez va tomando forma|work=LaNaranjaEnElAire.com.ar|date=August 3, 2011|access-date=July 12, 2016|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160816111421/http://lanaranjaenelaire.com.ar/2011/08/03/tna-san-martin-de-marcos-juarez-va-tomando-forma/ |archive-date=16 August 2016 |url-status=dead}}</ref> Brussino joined [[Club de Regatas Corrientes|Regatas Corrientes]] on July 22, 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://interbasquet.wordpress.com/2012/07/22/nicolas-brussino-se-incorpora-a-regatas-de-corrientes/|title=Nicolas Brussino se incorpora a Regatas de Corrientes|work=InterBasquet.Wordpress.com|date=July 22, 2012|access-date=July 12, 2016|language=es}}</ref> Before the 2012–13 season, it was discovered that Brussino had a heart problem. This congenital disease saw an abnormal electrical connection between the atria and ventricles.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pickandroll.com.ar/noticias/00024540/brussino-un-ejemplo-de-la-cantera-regatense/|title=Brussino, un ejemplo de la cantera regatense|work=PickAndRoll.com.ar|date=April 16, 2013|access-date=July 12, 2016|language=es}}</ref> Despite this, he still managed 29 games for Corrientes, averaging 1.9 points and 1.1 rebounds per game, while helping Corrientes win the 2012–13 [[Liga Nacional de Básquet|LNB]] championship.

In 2013–14, Brussino averaged 6.0 points and 2.6 rebounds in 55 games, and in 2014–15, he again played in 55 games and averaged 9.4 points, 3.2 rebounds, and 1.3 assists per game.

===Peñarol (2015–2016)===
On August 1, 2015, Brussino signed with [[Club Atlético Peñarol (Mar del Plata)|Peñarol]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://basquetplus.com/articulo/nicol%C3%A1s-brussino-es-el-nuevo-refuerzo-de-pe%C3%B1arol|title=Nicolás Brussino es el nuevo refuerzo de Peñarol|work=BasquetPlus.com|date=August 1, 2015|access-date=July 12, 2016|language=es}}</ref> In 2015–16, he averaged 14.6 points, 5.5 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.5 steals in 59 games.

===Dallas Mavericks (2016–2017)===
On July 15, 2016, Brussino signed with the [[Dallas Mavericks]].<ref>{{cite web|first=Arya|last=Ahmadi|url=http://www.mavs.com/maverick-sign-guard-forward-nicholas-brussino/|title=Maverick sign G/F Nicolas Brussino|work=Mavs.com|date=July 15, 2016|access-date=July 15, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160818220211/http://www.mavs.com/maverick-sign-guard-forward-nicholas-brussino/|archive-date=August 18, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> He made his NBA debut in the Mavericks' season opener on October 26, 2016, recording one assist in 34 seconds of game time in a 130–121 overtime loss to the [[Indiana Pacers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore?gameId=400899379|title=Mavericks vs. Pacers - Box Score|work=ESPN.com|date=October 26, 2016|access-date=October 26, 2016}}</ref> On March 15, 2017, he scored eight of his season-high 11 points in the fourth quarter of the Mavericks' 112–107 win over the [[Washington Wizards]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400900399|title=Nowitzki, Barnes help Mavericks beat Wizards 112-107|work=ESPN.com|date=March 15, 2017|access-date=March 16, 2017}}</ref> He also had nine rebounds in the game while playing 23 minutes off the bench.<ref>{{cite web|last=Sefko|first=Eddie|url=http://sportsday.dallasnews.com/dallas-mavericks/mavericks/2017/03/15/nicolas-brussino-makes-big-opportunity-deliver-mavericks-win-washington|title=Nicolas Brussino makes most of big opportunity to deliver the Mavericks a win over Washington|work=DallasNews.com|date=March 15, 2017|access-date=March 16, 2017}}</ref> On April 4, 2017, he had a season-high 13 points along with seven rebounds and five assists in a 98–87 loss to the [[Sacramento Kings]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=400900541|title=McLemore's big second half lifts Kings past Mavericks, 98-87|work=ESPN.com|date=April 4, 2017|access-date=April 5, 2017}}</ref> During his rookie season, he had multiple assignments with the [[Texas Legends]] of the [[NBA Development League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://dleague.nba.com/news/assignments/|title=2016-17 NBA Assignments|work=NBA.com|access-date=March 9, 2017|archive-date=June 28, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150628000000/http://dleague.nba.com/news/assignments/|url-status=dead}}</ref> On July 20, 2017, he was waived by the Mavericks.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavericks-waive-nicolas-brussino/|title=Mavericks waive Nicolas Brussino|work=Mavs.com|date=July 20, 2017|access-date=July 20, 2017}}</ref>

===Atlanta Hawks (2017)===
On July 22, 2017, Brussino was claimed off waivers by the [[Atlanta Hawks]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/hawks-claim-nicolas-brussino-waivers|title=Hawks Claim Nicolas Brussino Off Waivers|work=NBA.com|date=July 22, 2017|access-date=July 22, 2017}}</ref> On December 8, 2017, he was waived by the Hawks after appearing in four games. He also appeared in eight contests with the [[Erie BayHawks (2017–)|Erie BayHawks]], Atlanta's [[NBA G League]] affiliate.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/news/hawks-waive-nico-brussino|title=Hawks Waive Nico Brussino|work=NBA.com|date=December 8, 2017|access-date=December 8, 2017}}</ref>

===Herbalife Gran Canaria (2018)===
On 31 December 2017, Brussino signed with Spanish club [[CB Gran Canaria|Herbalife Gran Canaria]] for the rest of the [[2017–18 ACB season|2017–18 season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=137405|publisher=ACB.com|language=es|date=31 December 2017|access-date=31 December 2017|title=El alero argentino Nicolás Brussino se incorpora al Herbalife Gran Canaria}}</ref>

===Iberostar Tenerife (2018–2019)===
On July 26, 2018, Brussino signed a one–plus–one deal with [[CB 1939 Canarias|Iberostar Tenerife]] of the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{cite news |title=ACB.COM - Brussino cambia de isla y se viste de aurinegro |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=142329 |access-date=26 July 2018 |work=www.acb.com |date=26 July 2018 |language=es-ES |archive-date=26 July 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180726135201/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=142329 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===Basket Zaragoza (2019–2021)===
On July 5, 2019, Brussino signed a two-year deal with [[Basket Zaragoza]] of the [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Nicolas Brussino joins Zaragoza |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/nicolas-brussino-joins-zaragoza/ |access-date=5 July 2019 |work=Sportando |date=5 July 2019 |archive-date=16 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211116113307/https://sportando.basketball/en/nicolas-brussino-joins-zaragoza/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> He averaged 9.8 points and 4 rebounds during the 2019–20 season. On June 12, 2020, Brussino re-signed with the team.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zaragoza re-signs Nicolas Brussino |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/zaragoza-re-signs-nicolas-brussino/ |website=Sportando |access-date=June 12, 2020 |date=June 12, 2020}}</ref>

===Return to Herbalife Gran Canaria (2021–2026)===
On July 1, 2021, he joined [[CB Gran Canaria|Herbalife Gran Canaria]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/nicolas-brussino-returns-to-gran-canaria/|title=Nicolas Brussino returns to Gran Canaria|last=|first=|date=July 1, 2021|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=July 2, 2021}}</ref>

===Return to Zaragoza (2026–present)===
On July 12, 2026, Brussino returned to Zaragoza, signing a two-season deal.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nico Brussino regresa al Casademont Zaragoza |url=https://www.acb.com/es/liga/noticias/nico-brussino-regresa-al-casademont-zaragoza-145571 |website=acb.com |date=12 July 2026 |access-date=12 July 2026 |language=es}}</ref>

==National team career==
[[File:Nicolás Brussino 2015 (cropped).jpg|thumb|Brussino in 2015]]
Brussino is a senior [[Argentine national basketball team]] member. He won a silver medal with Argentina's senior national team at the [[2015 FIBA Americas Championship]]. He also played at the [[Basketball at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2016 Summer Olympics]], and at the [[2017 FIBA AmeriCup]], where he won a silver medal and was named to the [[FIBA AmeriCup All-Tournament Team|All-Tournament Team]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20170829164112/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp//q/Nicolas%20BRUSSINO/pid/83922/_//players.html Nicolas BRUSSINO (ARG).]</ref>

In 2019, he participated in the team that won the [[Basketball at the 2019 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|Pan American gold medal in Lima]]. He was included in the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup squads|Argentine squad]] for the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup]] and clinched the silver medal with Argentina, which emerged as runners-up to Spain at the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/en/more-sports/2019/09/15/5d7e4cf846163f8f878b45d0.html|title=Spain seal second FIBA World Cup with win over Argentina|date=15 September 2019|website=MARCA in English|language=en|access-date=19 September 2019}}</ref>

In 2022, Brussino won the gold medal in the [[2022 FIBA AmeriCup]] held in [[Recife]], [[Brazil]]. He was one of Argentina's [[small forward]]s in the tournament.

==Personal life==
Brussino, who has Italian ancestry (the surname was originally Bruscino), received Italian citizenship. Brussino's brother, Juan, also plays basketball in Argentina.<ref>{{cite web|first=Gabriel|last=Rosenbaun|url=https://basquetblog.wordpress.com/2012/05/09/nicolas-brussino-me-lo-tomo-como-una-experiencia-unica-e-inolvidable/|title=Nicolás Brussino, sobre la citación a la Selección: Me lo tomo como una experiencia única e inolvidable|work=BasquetBlog.Wordpress.com|date=May 9, 2012|access-date=July 12, 2016|language=es}}</ref>
